### ⚠️ Important Note on Time Limits:
Motor vehicle accident claims must be lodged with the CTP insurer within **six months** of the accident.

It's important to act quickly and seek legal advice as soon as possible.

Most of these firms offer **free initial consultations**, so you can speak with them before committing to anything. I hope you recover soon!
